item.title: Mirabai Chanu Smashes Three Records At National Weightlifting Championships
item.description: National Weightlifting Championships: Olympic silver medallist Mirabai Chanu gave an outstanding performance at the National Weightlifting Championship 2026 with three national records in the women’s 48kg category on Wednesday.

item.title: Aaron George’s 115 Powers India into U-19 World Cup Final with Record Chase
item.description: Aaron George’s brilliant 115 led India to a record run-chase against Afghanistan, sealing a seven-wicket win and a spot in the 2026 U-19 World Cup final.

item.title: Man City Beat Newcastle To Reach Carabao Cup Final
item.description: Manchester City cruised into their 10th Carabao Cup final after sweeping aside holders Newcastle United 5-1 on aggregate in a dominant semi-final display at the Etihad Stadium.

item.title: ICC Reveals Broadcast Details For Men’s T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: Sky Sports Main Event: The ICC has unveiled the broadcast plans for the Men’s T20 World Cup, featuring 20 teams and 55 matches, running from February 7 to March 8.

item.title: Athletic Bilbao, Real Sociedad Into Copa Semis After Away Wins
item.description: Athletic Bilbao: Inaki Williams scored a 96th-minute winner to see Athletic Bilbao beat Valencia 2-1 to reach the semifinal of the Copa del Rey.

item.title: Did Not Expect But I Will Be Back On The Field This Early, Says Tilak Ahead Of T20 WC Title Defence
item.description: DY Patil Stadium: India all-rounder Tilak Varma, who joined the national side after recovering from an injury recently, expressed gratitude to the BCCI and the Centre of Excellence (CoE) for helping him return to action sooner than expected.

item.title: The Leela Maharaja Sawai Man Singh Polo Cup: Jaipur Polo Team Beat Suhana All Stars
item.description: The Leela Maharaja Sawai Man: Jaipur Polo Team delivered a composed performance to register a 7–4.5 victory over Suhana All Stars Polo Team in the opening match of The Leela Maharaja Sawai Man Singh Polo Cup.

item.title: WPL 2026 Final: DC Eye First Title As Friends Jemi-Smriti Face Off
item.description: Royal Challengers Bangalore: The grand finale of the Women’s Premier League (WPL) 2026 promises a thrilling contest, with the stakes at an all-time high as Delhi Capitals (DC) face Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) here at the BCA Stadium (Kotambi)

item.title: Vinesh Calls Out Haryana Wrestling Assoc. Over 'unfair Selection Criteria' For Fed Cup
item.description: Haryana Chief Minister Manohar Lal: In a fiery outburst, star wrestler Vinesh Phogat has hit out at the Haryana Wrestling Association for what she calls "unfair" selection criteria for the Federation Cup 2026.

item.title: The Hundred That Announced the Arrival of Kapil Dev
item.description: Kapil Dev’s unbeaten 126 against West Indies in Delhi in 1979 was the innings that established him as a genuine all-rounder and announced his arrival in Test cricket.
